content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ICSIL Driver Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the ICSIL Driver position is scheduled for 25th September 2026. Candidates are advised to report at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Driver post at ICSIL?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Matriculation or 10th standard. Additionally, a valid Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) driving license is mandatory for this post.

faq.question: Q3. How many years of experience are needed for the Driver position?
faq.answer: Applicants are required to have a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in driving to be eligible for the Driver post at ICSIL.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Driver post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Driver position is 50 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Driver post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Driver post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 22,411/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for ICSIL Driver Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee for all categories, including General, OBC, SC, and ST, is Rs. 590/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Driver role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Walk-in Interview, followed by a Skill Test, and finally Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview for ICSIL Driver Recruitment 2026 going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted in New Delhi, Delhi. The specific address and reporting time will be detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Driver position at ICSIL is a contractual job. Candidates will be appointed on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.
